summary: UGI Corp filed an 8-K reporting that its indirect subsidiaries AmeriGas Partners and AmeriGas Finance Corp priced a private offering of $500 million in aggregate principal amount of 6.875% senior unsecured notes due 2031. The notes were issued under Rule 144A/Reg S. Net proceeds together with $300 million from a prior equity contribution and cash on hand will be used to repurchase and redeem all of the Issuers' 5.750% senior notes due 2027. Closing is expected on or about May 20, 2026, subject to customary conditions. This is a routine debt refinancing with no special-situation M&A, tender offer, or activist elements; the issuer is leveraging new debt to retire existing notes.
